method: Exploratory fixed baselines. Exact anchor value/time from original R2 issue. Past ANA level exactly anchor-1h from D1, requiring created_at <= issue generation. Persistence keeps anchor; trend projects last-hour change linearly from actual anchor timestamp. Same production-selected cases in all arms. No fitted parameters, clipping, switching or promotion.
limitations: Single already-inspected flood episode, not an independent holdout.
D1 created_at does not establish absence of later revisions; all timestamps/values retained for checking.
Straight trend can overshoot near peak or changing dam operations; this comparison alone is not a production replacement.
